data.title: JPMorgan estimates $50 billion has flowed into crypto this year as momentum improves into Q4
data.summary_raw: JPMorgan analysts estimate around $50 billion has flowed into digital assets this year, equal to an annualized pace of $66 billion.

data.title: NFL tells Supreme Court prediction market sports contracts are gambling, not swaps
data.summary_raw: The NFL filed an amicus brief urging the Supreme Court to hear New Jersey's case, arguing Kalshi's sports contracts are gambling, not CFTC-regulated swaps.

data.title: Strategy shareholders face dilution drag despite brighter bitcoin forecasts, TD Cowen says
data.summary_raw: TD Cowen kept its $260 price target on Strategy (MSTR) as dilution limits the benefit of higher bitcoin forecasts.
